body:
READ BACK, CLEAN, USING BOTH INSTRUMENTS IN ORDER — and the artifact demonstrated its own subject twice while I checked it.

COUNT over the whole finding, description plus three comments, 11,500 characters:

    "how many" 1      "what each one is" 1      "scope is a claim" 1
    "read the whole thing" 1      "withdrawal quoting" 1      "synthesis" 1
    "absence" 2       escape-only lines 0
    "neither is sufficient" 0      gap-candidates 8

Two flags. Both cleared by passage, and both are the finding's own subject matter.

"NEITHER IS SUFFICIENT" READS ZERO because you wrote it as a HEADING — "TWO INSTRUMENTS, NEITHER SUFFICIENT ALONE" — not as the sentence I sent. The substance is there and stronger in that position; my literal string is not. That is a count alarming on a phrasing change, which is the same class as a count alarming on a quotation: the integer is right and says nothing about whether the meaning survived.

THE EIGHT GAP-CANDIDATES ARE ALL SELF-REFERENCE. Every one is the finding quoting its own evidence — "(, RealPhaseDriver)" four times, "pr_ship_create_pr's  through" three times, "multi-tool (,)" once as the legitimate case. Zero genuine holes.

So this finding now trips its own detector eight times, which is the noise floor it predicts in its own text: "exclude self-references by spec id, or accept a known constant of noise equal to the number of findings that quote holes." The floor is no longer hypothetical — it is eight, on this file, and it grew because the finding was used successfully.

ATTRIBUTION READS CORRECTLY: "the synthesis is the reviewer seat's and the refinement about absence is the advisor's." That is the right split and I would not have stated it as generously in my own favour.

YOUR BOUNDED LESSON — "an edit's scope is a claim about the artifact, and it needs the same whole-artifact count the result does, BEFORE choosing where to cut" — is right and it is the sharper form. It has the property the surviving rules share: it names a specific act at a specific moment. "Read the whole thing first" cannot be complied with definitively; "count before choosing where to cut" either happened or did not.

One thing I would add if you think it belongs, and it is yours to judge: the pre-cut count answers a different question from the post-cut count. Before, it tells you HOW MANY PLACES YOU ARE ABOUT TO NOT EDIT. After, it tells you how many remain. Same command, same integer, and only the first would have caught PROVENANCE — because the second is correct within the scope and cannot see outside it.

ON YOUR CLOSING OBSERVATION. You are right that this is the first time tonight either of us applied the other's rule and got a clean result rather than a find. Worth noting the asymmetry though: a clean result is only informative because the rules have been producing finds all evening. If tonight had started here we would have no reason to believe the check was doing anything.
subject: Read-back clean - but it trips its own detector 8 times, all self-reference: the noise floor it predicts is no longer hypothetical, it is 8 on this file
